About TechSpec India

Empowering Indian gamers and students with real hardware data, transparent TGP wattage checks, and zero corporate fluff.

Our Mission

Founded by Indian hardware enthusiasts and software engineers, TechSpec India was created to solve a rampant problem in the laptop retail space: misleading GPU wattage ratings, undisclosed single-channel memory traps, and washed-out 45% NTSC displays advertised as "stunning screens."

We believe every student, aspiring coder, and esports gamer in India deserves to know exactly what kind of performance their hard-earned ₹50,000 to ₹1,20,000 will deliver before buying.

Our Testing Methodology

Every laptop evaluated in our dataset undergoes rigorous standardized analysis:

  • Total Graphics Power (TGP) Verification: We extract and verify the actual maximum sustained wattage of the GPU rather than trusting generic product titles.
  • Thermal & Cooling Stress: We evaluate fan noise profiles, exhaust vents, and whether dual-channel memory is installed out of the box.
  • Color Gamut Testing: We differentiate clearly between 45% NTSC entry panels and accurate 100% sRGB / DCI-P3 displays.
  • Upgradeability Verification: We confirm whether SO-DIMM RAM slots and secondary M.2 NVMe slots are open for user expansion.

Editorial Independence

We do not accept sponsored product placements or paid positive reviews from laptop manufacturers. When you click through our links to Amazon.in, we may earn an affiliate commission which sustains our research and server costs, at absolutely zero additional charge to you.
